nodes.name: Article Webhook
nodes.notes:
PUBLISH / EDIT (article EO log -> archive.org, append-only)
POST /webhook/site/article-npj
Authorization: Bearer <matrix token>
Body: { slug, line, message? }   (line = ONE EO event: INS publish, REC edit, or EVA feedback)
Gate: Matrix admin always; editor only if new OR an assignee on the article's genesis.
Reads npj-article-<slug>/<slug>.jsonl from archive.org, appends `line`, PUTs it back
(read-modify-append — IA S3 has no atomic append, so this node owns the merge).
The reader folds that same file. No GitHub. Returns { ok, url, bytes, base_sha }.

nodes.name: Article Fetch Roles
nodes.notes: Roles still live in site/layout.json on GitHub (the layout is published there). Only the ARTICLE content moved to archive.org.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: ($json.error || 'unauthorized'), user: $json.user_id || null, role: $json.role || null }) }}

nodes.name: Article Fetch Existing
nodes.notes: Current append-only log (404 -> empty for a brand-new article).

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: ($json.error || 'forbidden'), user: $json.user_id || null, role: $json.role || null, slug: $json.slug || null }) }}

nodes.name: Article IA Put
nodes.notes: Reuses the IA S3 keys (same as the publish/mirror flows). Overwrites the item's <slug>.jsonl with the appended log.
